changelog:
Initial release of the Noveum AI reliability & QA engineer skill.

- Guides users through integrating Noveum.ai end-to-end in LLM, agent, or voice app codebases.
- Supports integration of the noveum-trace SDK with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, LiveKit, Pipecat, or manual setup.
- Automates verification of trace completeness, building evaluation datasets, running evaluations, NovaPilot diagnosis, backtesting with AutoFix, and applying fixes as pull requests.
- Ensures context-safe handling for large trace and report payloads.
- Connects securely via the Noveum MCP server using OAuth or API key.
- Provides a step-by-step checklist with strict acceptance criteria and references for each setup stage.
